description: Search, read and add to your Trilium Notes (TriliumNext) over its ETAPI: a lean index of the note tree, search, outline-first reading, and creating, appending and labelling notes (no delete or move). Set TRILIUM_URL to your Trilium and TRILIUM_ETAPI_TOKEN as a user environment variable; TRILIUM_READ_ONLY=1 for reading only. Requires Node 18+ on PATH.
